description: The evidence file a sweep lane writes; it carries no local file paths.
title: AEE Keyboard and Pointer Sweep Lane

pressedBy.description: Who pressed the controls in activated: the sweep (the default), or the test itself, whose presses AEE only watched (see observePresses); such a record has no Tab stops.

blockedNavigations.description: Navigations outside the allowed origins: stopped before they left the page, or, when a redirect took one there (the browser follows a redirect before the guard is asked), not read.

failedNavigations.description: Pages on the site a press set out for that did not load: Chrome showed its own error page, so the sweep read nothing there and compared the click with the key press by where each set out for.

framesNotRead.description: Frames whose content the sweep did not check, and why: one showing a page outside the allowed origins or Chrome's error page, one inside such a frame, or one no session could read. The frame element on the page is still swept.

failedNavigation.description: A page a press set out for that did not load: Chrome showed its own error page instead.

url.description: Where it set out for, with no credentials, query values or fragment.

framePath.description: Inside a frame: the iframe elements it is inside, outermost first, each as a path in the document that holds it (as axe-core's target lists a node inside frames).

text.description: The text it shows, when the accessibility tree gives it no name: what a sighted person sees.

targetBox.description: Where the element is on the lane's full-page screenshot, or on screenshot when it has one.

screenshot.description: The full-page screenshot, beside the record, of the page as a press the test made left it, for a finding of that press; the lane has no screenshot of its own.

label.description: Its accessible name, which a screen reader announces when Tab reaches it.

role.description: Its role in the accessibility tree.

focusVisible.description: Whether the stop and its surroundings look different with keyboard focus than without it, compared pixel for pixel. Absent when it could not be measured, or was not checked.

notChecked.description: Why its focus was not checked: it is a frame whose page the sweep does not read, so its pictures cover it. Names the site when its page is outside the allowed origins.

focusCrop.description: The file, beside this record, showing the stop with keyboard focus.

targetBox.description: Where the stop is on the lane's full-page screenshot.
